lessons.headline: Scrimshaw Jukebox
summaryBullets: Tool: Scrimshaw Jukebox I wanted to see if Claude Opus 5.5 could compose music, so I tried this: I want you to write some computer game music for me.

First design simple text based format for the music and build an artifact that can play it out loud - include some example tracks in that artifact I am looking for music of the quality of the original secret of Monkey…
I wonder if the ability to compose competent music is similar to the 3D graphics thing - a new capability for tex
